constraints.initial: Required object with at most 64 named scalar inputs. Values are null, boolean, finite number or string of at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes.
constraints.computed: Optional object with at most 64 named expressions. Names must not duplicate initial inputs; dependencies must resolve without cycles.
constraints.sources: Optional object with at most 16 named Task sources. Each descriptor permits only type="tasks", nonzero projectId UUID, optional filter (all, active, review, done) and optional integer limit 1–1000. Authorization is checked independently of the descriptor.

events: Descendant input changes update only this viewer’s scope instance.
accessibility: Scope adds no mandatory visual border; preserve authored reading order and labels.
authoring.fallback: Unavailable or revoked sources remain unavailable; do not silently substitute zero or an empty successful result.
authoring.capture: Record selected scalar inputs, definitions, observations and evaluated values in the manifest; materialize children inside a Stack.
limits: 64 initial inputs, 64 computed values and 16 sources per scope.

constraints.repair: Give initial inputs and computed declarations distinct names.

accessibility: Keep DOM reading order equal to authored child order.
authoring.fallback: Render children in document order.
authoring.capture: Retain layout and recursively freeze children.
limits: Document limits: 10,000 nodes and depth 32.

accessibility: Collapse columns on narrow surfaces without changing reading order.
authoring.fallback: Render children in document order.
authoring.capture: Retain layout and recursively freeze children.
limits: Use only the catalog columns and gap constraints.

constraints.when: Required expression resolving to a boolean; truthy coercion is not supported.

accessibility: Hidden descendants are not interactive; evaluation status must not steal focus.
authoring.fallback: Show unavailable/loading status rather than treating evaluation failure as false.
authoring.capture: Evaluate when once; omit false descendants and materialize true descendants in a Stack.
limits: Expression and document budgets apply even when nested.

constraints.items: Required expression resolving to an array. Scalar items are their own keys; object items use keyField, default id. Keys must be non-null scalars and unique within this Repeat.
constraints.keyField: Object key field defaults to id. Keep keys stable across sorting and refresh to preserve local instance state.

events: Descendant controls update their keyed viewer instance.
accessibility: Preserve collection order and distinct control labels/IDs for rendered instances.
authoring.fallback: Report missing or duplicate keys and unavailable collections; do not reuse another item’s state.
authoring.capture: Expand keyed instances once and materialize their evaluated children in a Stack; retain instance paths in the manifest.
limits: At most 1000 items, 8 nested Repeat levels and a shared 10,000 rendered-node budget.

constraints.action: Closed action object: setState requires name and expression value; copy/continue require literal text of 1–4096 UTF-8 bytes; navigate requires safe HTTPS href up to 2048 bytes; openEntity requires entityType task/page and nonzero entityId UUID, with optional nonzero projectId for page. Unknown fields are rejected. Continue requires host review and normal authorization.

events: Activate the declared host action; setState changes viewer-local state only.
accessibility: Use the label as the accessible button name; retain keyboard activation and visible focus.
authoring.fallback: Disable unsupported host actions and actions in comparison/snapshot views; show action failures without claiming success.
authoring.capture: Materialize the label and action-unavailable text; never execute an action during capture.
limits: Only the five registered action types; no arbitrary script or mutation action.

constraints.bind: Required name of writable initial state in the nearest declaring Scope; computed values are not writable. The value must be a string of at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes.

events: Input changes update bound viewer-local state; no product mutation is implied.
accessibility: Use an explicit associated label, native keyboard behavior and visible focus.
authoring.fallback: Enable viewer-local input only in live views or current validated interactive previews with an available scope. Disable inputs in stale previews, ordinary comparisons and immutable captures; retain an explicit unavailable state.
authoring.capture: Materialize the label and selected scalar value as text; record the value in the manifest.
limits: Bound text is limited to 4096 UTF-8 bytes.

constraints.bind: Required name of writable initial state in the nearest declaring Scope; computed values are not writable. The value must be a finite number within the declared range.
constraints.max: Optional finite upper bound; min must not exceed max.

events: Input changes update bound viewer-local state; no product mutation is implied.

limits: Only one declared scalar state binding per control.

constraints.repair: Set min less than or equal to max when both bounds are supplied.

constraints.options: Required array of 1–100 distinct strings, each at most 200 UTF-8 bytes.

events: Input changes update bound viewer-local state; no product mutation is implied.

constraints.value: Required bounded expression. Use explicit formatting for nontrivial scalar display; evaluation errors are not values.

accessibility: Keep the value inline in its containing prose; status changes must not move focus.
authoring.fallback: Render evaluation loading/unavailable status without inventing a value.
authoring.capture: Replace the expression with its evaluated literal and retain evidence in the manifest.
limits: Expression depth, steps, collection and output-byte budgets apply.

constraints.value: Required bounded expression; use explicit formatting for units and precision.

accessibility: Keep the visible label adjacent to the value.
authoring.fallback: Render evaluation loading/unavailable status without inventing a value.
authoring.capture: Replace the expression with its evaluated literal and retain the label and evidence.
limits: Expression depth, steps, collection and output-byte budgets apply.

constraints.data: Required expression resolving to at most 1000 objects. y must be a finite number; scatter x must be a finite number, while line/bar x accepts strings or finite numbers.
constraints.x: Field used for horizontal values/categories; missing or incompatible values are unavailable.

events: Chart inspection and its fallback table sorting/pagination are viewer-local.
accessibility: Provide an accessible chart label, a text summary of the plotted range and extrema, and the accompanying typed data table; never rely only on color or hover.
authoring.fallback: Always include a data table; show invalid or empty-data states explicitly.
authoring.capture: Freeze evaluated rows as literals, preserve chart metadata and export tabular data.
limits: At most 1000 rows; only line, bar and scatter variants.

constraints.data: Required expression resolving to an array of at most 1000 objects. Cells must match their declared column types; unavailable values are identified explicitly.
constraints.columns: Required array of 1–20 objects, each containing exactly key, label and type. Keys are unique safe fields up to 128 UTF-8 bytes; labels are 1–200 UTF-8 bytes; type is string, number, boolean or date.

events: Column sorting and pagination change only the current viewer’s table view.
accessibility: Use semantic table headers with sort state and labelled pagination controls; allow deliberate horizontal overflow.
authoring.fallback: Show invalid, empty and unavailable data states; do not display mismatched cells as valid values.
authoring.capture: Freeze evaluated rows and column metadata; export retained rows rather than refetching live data.
limits: At most 1000 rows, 20 columns and 100 rows per page.
